parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=8 (val_bpb 1.0033). This is a significant improvement over my previous best (1.0622). The larger model capacity seems to pay off even with standard hyperparameters. Next, I will try to optimize the learning rate for this DEPTH=8 configuration, testing MATRIX_LR=0.06 to see if stability improves.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 8 and lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.06 to see if the larger model stabilizes and improves further.
